title: Distribute into five buckets, sort each bucket, and concatenate
summary: Ten decimals are distributed by value among five buckets. Sorting each bucket in ascending order and concatenating them in bucket order gives a sorted array.
context: The input is nums = [0.49, 0.96, 0.82, 0.09, 0.57, 0.43, 0.91, 0.75, 0.15, 0.37]. All values are floating-point numbers in [0, 1). There are five buckets of width 0.2.
description: Place each value in the interval that contains it, including the left endpoint and excluding the right. Then sort the elements within each bucket. The five buckets in the middle already show both operations complete: the values are in sorted order, not insertion order.
Finally concatenate the buckets in increasing interval order. Since their ranges do not overlap and each bucket is sorted, the entire resulting array is sorted.

steps.title: Concatenate the buckets in order
steps.explanation: The 5 intervals do not overlap and each bucket is sorted. Take their elements in bucket order from [0, 0.2) through [0.8, 1.0) to form the final ascending array.
steps.key_state: Buckets concatenated into [0.09, 0.15, 0.37, 0.43, 0.49, 0.57, 0.75, 0.82, 0.91, 0.96]. Sorting is complete.
steps.announcement: The buckets have been concatenated in order. Sorting is complete.
